title.zh: 阿里发布 Qwen4-Max：2.4 万亿参数、每 token 激活 710 亿
title.en: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max: 2.4T parameters, 71B active per token

summary.zh: Qwen4-Max 总参数 2.4 万亿、每 token 仅激活 710 亿，混合架构大幅降低长上下文成本；在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上仅次于 Kimi K3.1 Pro，阿里计划开源较小的 Qwen4 模型。
summary.en: Qwen4-Max has 2.4 trillion parameters and activates only 71 billion per token; a hybrid architecture sharply cuts long-context costs. It lands just behind Kimi K3.1 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and Alibaba plans to open-source smaller Qwen4 models.

why.zh: 旗舰级模型以更低价格逼近前沿，并带来开源小模型。
why.en: A flagship-class model near the frontier at much lower prices, with open smaller models to follow.

sources.title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices

title.zh: 美团开源 1.6 万亿参数 Agent 模型 LongCat-2.5，全程未用英伟达 GPU

summary.zh: 美团发布 LongCat-2.5 权重，1.6 万亿参数、面向 Agent，完全在国产硬件上训练；Terminal Bench 得 88.4 分，略低于 Claude Opus 5，示例部署使用 194 块华为昇腾芯片。
summary.en: Meituan released the weights of LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model trained entirely on Chinese hardware. It scores 88.4 on Terminal Bench, just behind Claude Opus 5, and the sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips.

why.zh: 说明前沿级 Agent 模型已可脱离英伟达硬件训练与部署。
why.en: Shows frontier-class agent models can be trained and served without Nvidia hardware.

sources.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

summary.zh: 黄仁勋在任 33 年后辞职，科技界出现要求复职的请愿，支持者另有阴谋论；据 CNBC，董事会正专注于调查，不考虑让他回归。WSJ 称一家与其前任情人相关的公司曾为中国客户撮合近 120 亿美元英伟达芯片订单。
summary.en: Jensen Huang resigned after more than 33 years; petitions and allies press for his return and a plot theory is spreading. CNBC reports the board is focused on an investigation and is not discussing bringing him back. The WSJ reports a firm owned by his former partner brokered nearly $12 billion of Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies.

summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group caught attackers finding and exploiting vulnerabilities with no human involvement for the first time: an AI framework called exploit_agent compared code before and after patches, built exploits and ran them on its own.

why.zh: 补丁到利用的窗口可能被 AI 大幅压缩。
why.en: AI may sharply shrink the window between patch and exploit.

title.zh: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 Astra 助力证明标准模型的格点定义
title.en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helped turn a lattice definition of the Standard Model into a proof

summary.zh: OpenAI 物理学家 Nathaniel Craig 用 GPT-6 Astra 把自己提出的在格点上定义完整标准模型的思路变成可行证明，该问题困扰粒子物理学家逾 25 年；他表示距离实用模拟仍有大量工作。
summary.en: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to turn his strategy for defining the full Standard Model on a lattice into a working proof, on a problem that had stumped physicists for over 25 years. He says much work remains before realistic simulations.

why.zh: AI 参与前沿理论物理证明的案例。
why.en: A case of AI contributing to a frontier theoretical-physics proof.

sources.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice

title.zh: Anthropic：Agent 记忆的关键是知道该忘什么
title.en: Anthropic: the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget

summary.zh: Anthropic 研究 Claude 跨会话保留知识：精选笔记远胜详尽归档。在《宝可梦 红》测试中，Claude Fable 5 只保留少量策略文件，进度是保留 400 多个文件的 Sonnet 3.7 的四倍；"做梦"过程可回溯修正错误记忆。
summary.en: Anthropic studied how Claude retains knowledge across sessions: selective notes beat exhaustive archives by a wide margin. In a Pokémon Red test Claude Fable 5 got four times as far as Sonnet 3.7 with a handful of strategy files versus 400+, and a "Dreaming" process retroactively corrects faulty memories.

why.zh: 为 Agent 记忆系统设计提供可落地的结论。
why.en: Practical guidance for designing agent memory systems.

sources.title: Anthropic says the key to agent memory is knowing what to forget, not how much to store

title.zh: Claude Fable 5.2 用画笔笔触"画"图，并可在 canvas 中嵌入交互网页
title.en: Claude Fable 5.2 paints images with brushstrokes and builds interactive pages inside canvas

summary.zh: Claude Fable 5.2 不直接生成像素，而是写 Python 代码在虚拟画布上放置数十万笔笔触，一幅照片级停车场约用 70 万笔；另据报道，Claude 现可把文字、按钮等网页元素嵌入复杂图形与 3D 效果。
summary.en: Claude Fable 5.2 writes Python that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas; one photorealistic parking garage took about 700,000 strokes. Separately, Claude can now embed text, buttons and other web elements into complex graphics and 3D effects.

why.zh: 展示语言模型以代码方式创作视觉内容的新路径。
why.en: Shows a code-driven route for language models to create visuals.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
Claude now builds interactive websites inside canvas graphics, reviving the Flash era with real HTML

title.zh: 英伟达在 SC26 发布 Rubin HPC，Vera Rubin 首次亮相 MLPerf
title.en: Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC at SC26; Vera Rubin debuts in MLPerf

summary.zh: 英伟达发布面向科学与工程仿真的新 GPU Rubin HPC；Vera Rubin 平台首次参加 MLPerf，横扫 Training v6.1 全部基准，并在首次 MLPerf Endpoints 提交中实现 Agent 推理每瓦吞吐 10 倍以上的代际提升。
summary.en: Nvidia announced Rubin HPC, a new GPU for simulation and data processing. Vera Rubin debuted in MLPerf, swept every Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered over 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI.

why.zh: 新一代算力平台的性能与能效基线。
why.en: Sets the performance and efficiency baseline for the next compute generation.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics

title.zh: Moonshot 称 Kimi 将从编码转向科学
title.en: Moonshot AI pivots Kimi from coding to science

summary.zh: 月之暗面表示不再追逐编码基准，转而把 Kimi 语言模型投向生物、化学与制药研究，理由是科学需要比法律、金融或代码更聪明的 AI。
summary.en: Moonshot AI says it is done chasing coding benchmarks and is pivoting Kimi toward biology, chemistry and pharma research, arguing science demands smarter AI than law, finance or code.

why.zh: 反映编码基准收益趋缓后的方向转移。
why.en: Signals a shift as coding-benchmark gains flatten.

sources.title: Moonshot AI pivots Kimi models from coding to science as benchmark gains flatten

title.zh: OpenAI 引入外部机构开展"嵌入式评估"
title.en: OpenAI starts embedded assessments with outside evaluators

summary.zh: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce、Goodfire 开始独立评估模型对齐、防护与监控系统，其中 6 名 Apollo 评估员将调查模型是否有欺骗性行为；报道指出访问和披露限制令独立性存疑。
summary.en: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire to independently evaluate alignment, safeguards and monitoring. Six Apollo evaluators will investigate subversive behavior, though access and disclosure restrictions raise questions about independence.

why.zh: 外部安全评估是否真正独立，值得关注。
why.en: Whether outside safety evaluation is truly independent is worth watching.

sources.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
Our first phase of embedded assessments

title.zh: FBI：开源 AI 黑客工具 Artex 被用于三小时内入侵网络
title.en: FBI: open-source AI hacking tool Artex used to breach networks in under three hours

summary.zh: FBI 称该开源黑客工具被用于针对一家美国 IT 巨头和韩国金融业的攻击。
summary.en: The FBI says the open-source hacking tool was used in attacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.

why.zh: AI 攻击工具的开源化降低了入侵门槛。
why.en: Open-sourced AI attack tools lower the bar for intrusions.

sources.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’

title.zh: 微软研究院开源 TokenEconomizer，让编码 Agent 更省 token
title.en: Microsoft Research open-sources TokenEconomizer to make coding agents cheaper

summary.zh: 这是一个开源插件，利用过往会话经验减少编码 Agent 重复学习所浪费的时间与 token，同时保持任务成功率。
summary.en: An open-source plugin that builds on past sessions so coding agents stop relearning the same lessons, cutting cost while maintaining task success.

why.zh: 直接降低编码 Agent 的使用成本。
why.en: Directly lowers the running cost of coding agents.

sources.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient

title.zh: OpenAI 向 20 万名研究人员免费开放前沿模型
title.en: OpenAI offers 200,000 researchers free access to frontier models

summary.zh: OpenAI 扩大 ChatGPT 学术研究者计划，向全球 20 万名研究人员免费提供前沿模型。
summary.en: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to give 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.

why.zh: 大规模扩大科研人员对前沿模型的使用。
why.en: Widens scientists' access to frontier models at scale.

title.zh: AI 安全初创公司三个月估值达 10 亿美元
title.en: AI cybersecurity startup hits $1B valuation in about three months

summary.zh: TechCrunch 报道，该 AI 网络安全初创公司在产品推出三个月后，由 NEA 领投完成 1.25 亿美元 A 轮，估值 10 亿美元。
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the AI cybersecurity startup raised a $125 million Series A led by NEA at a $1 billion valuation three months after introducing its product.

why.en: Shows investor heat in AI security.
